name: 蘇莉芸
objective:
以科學方法探討聚合物特性，使學生了解分子結構與物性的關係、物性之測定方法及物性與加工應用上之關係。
The unique features of polymers are introduced.  Special
emphasis is given to the structuring effects of processing
on polymer morphology and properties.
schedule:
1. Introduction of Polymer Materials (1 week)
2. Synthesis and Fabrication of Polymer Materials  (2 week)
3. Chracterizations of Polymer Materials (3 week)
4. Compression Molding (2 week)
    Mid-term Exam (1 week)
5. Injection Molding (2 week) 
6. Transfer Molding (2 week)
7. Foaming (2 week)
8. Industry Information (2 week)
    Final Exam (1 week)
scorePolicy:
期中考 40%
期末分組報告與平時課堂活動 40%
出席成績 20%
(老師將視班級整體學習狀況、報告問答互動性，保留最終成績微調之權利，以確保公平性。)
materials:
“高分子加工”, 陳劉旺, 丁金超, 高立圖書.
“Fundamentals of Polymer Processing”, S. Middleman, McGraw-Hill, New York. 
“Polymer Processing”, J.-F Agassant, P. Avenas, J. –Ph. Sergent and P. J. Carreau, Oxford University Press, New York.
“Textbook of Polymer Science”, 3rd Edition, F. W. Billmeyer, Jr., John Wiley & Sons, Inc.
